name: Wizard
summary: A scholar of arcane magic with the widest spell list, a spellbook that grows every level and rituals for free.

recommended.note: Intelligence first, then Constitution for Concentration and Dexterity for AC.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast Wizard spells with Intelligence from a spellbook that starts with six level 1 spells.
features.text: You know three Wizard cantrips (more at levels 4 and 10) and can swap one after a Long Rest. Your spellbook starts with six level 1 Wizard spells and gains two Wizard spells of levels you can cast each Wizard level. You prepare spells from your book (Prepared Spells column) and can change them after a Long Rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability; an Arcane Focus or your spellbook can be your focus.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.summary: Cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a Ritual without preparing it.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.summary: Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest, recover slots totalling half your Wizard level (round up).
features.text: When you finish a Short Rest you can recover expended spell slots whose levels add up to no more than half your Wizard level (round up), none of level 6 or higher. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Scholar
features.summary: Expertise in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature or Religion that you're proficient in.

features.name: Wizard Subclass
features.text: You choose a Wizard subclass. From now on you gain each subclass feature when you reach its Wizard level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.summary: After a Short Rest, swap one prepared spell for another in your spellbook.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Wizard subclass.

features.text: Take an Epic Boon feat or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.

features.summary: Two level 3 spells always prepared, each cast once per rest without a slot.
